name: Disability access to services — UK official starting points
description: Official equality-regulator starting points that keep the Great Britain and Northern Ireland service-access frameworks separate: EHRC guidance for England, Scotland and Wales, and Equality Commission for Northern Ireland guidance.
intended_use: Use when a disabled or neurodivergent parent is having difficulty accessing a service and wants to inspect the official disability-access framework for the correct jurisdiction.
audience_or_context: Disabled people using services in the UK who need a jurisdiction signpost; use the regulator locator for the relevant nation.
limitations: This combined Resource is a jurisdiction signpost, not legal advice or a statement that the same statute applies across the UK.
The EHRC route covers England, Scotland and Wales; the Equality Commission route covers Northern Ireland under a separate legal framework.
Whether a person is legally disabled and whether a particular adjustment is reasonable depend on facts ND Oracle cannot decide.
conflicts_of_interest: The two regulators operate under different legal frameworks; ND Oracle deliberately preserves that split.
